name: The Manta Resort, Underwater Room
niche_feature: One Underwater Room: a three-level floating suite anchored about 250 m off Pemba shore, with the double bedroom four metres below the sea surface. The rest of the resort (villas, garden rooms) is ordinary accommodation.
evidence_quote: Suspended four meters below the surface of the Indian Ocean, the bedroom is the heart of this unique escape.
reason: Official page confirms a bedroom 4 m below the sea surface in a floating structure; it is a single room within a conventional resort.
page_issues: Official page does not mention a live-aboard host or private chef; unsupported
Room is anchored about 250 m off shore, not 'alone in the open ocean'
Superlatives ('most extraordinary sleeping experience anywhere', 'voted among world's most extraordinary') and 9.6 rating/234 reviews unsupported
Distances (Chake Chake 25 km, 80 km north of Zanzibar) unverified; resort is at Pemba's northern tip, about 1.5 h by road from the airport
Resort says a new room replaced the original (secondary source: May 2026); hatch/ladder/circular-chamber details may describe the old room
Resort has a three-night minimum stay and all-inclusive meals; page does not mention this

name: Pullman Maldives Maamutaa Resort
niche_feature: Only the Aqua Villas (two, per the resort's claim of 2 underwater bedrooms) have a submerged master bedroom beneath the lagoon plus an overwater bedroom; the other villas of the 122 are beach or overwater villas.
evidence_quote: This luxury two-level Aqua Villa has a submerged master bedroom combined with an overwater bedroom
reason: Official Aqua Villa page confirms a submerged bedroom in the lagoon; only 2 villas have it, the rest are ordinary or overwater villas.
page_issues: Page does not say there are only two Aqua Villas (resort says first in Maldives with 2 underwater bedrooms)

name: Utter Inn
niche_feature: Single-room floating hotel on Lake Mälaren by artist Mikael Genberg: bedroom three metres below the surface with panoramic windows. Tourist board says it cannot currently be booked; a 2026 guide says it did not operate and is for sale.
evidence_quote: När natten faller på är det dags att klättra ner till sovrummet med panoramafönster i alla fyra väderstreck – tre meter under vattenytan.
reason: Concept is a genuine underwater room, but Visit Västmanland says it cannot be booked now and a 2026 guide says it did not operate and is for sale.
page_issues: Not bookable: Visit Västmanland says 'Just nu går det inte att boka hotellet'; secondary 2026 guide says it did not operate and is for sale
No official website found; page implies current availability
Tourist board says there is no electricity (gas heating, power only for lamps) and a dry toilet; page's kitchenette/compact bathroom wording is unsupported
Kayak access and life jackets unsupported (source mentions a rubber boat); '3 km by boat' to city centre unverified
Surface area described as a 25 sqm floating pontoon plus a room above water; 'sitting area' and 'maximum two guests' not confirmed by this source
'World's first underwater hotel room' and 'one of the most discussed hotel concepts' are unsupported superlatives
